'''Gilag Pitaaani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nuknog/Legends|Nuknog]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] who resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. He was under the employ of the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Chenik Kruun]].<ref name="target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NERC">According to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', the events of ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', which include the [[Muunilinst Podrace|podrace]] on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] take place in [[0 ABY]].</ref> Pitaaani was among the five podracers who raced against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who ultimately won the [[Muunilinst Podrace|race]] on the outskirts of [[Pilaan]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Muunilinst. Pitanni piloted a [[Bin Gassi Racing Engines|Bin Gassi]] [[Quadrijet 4-Barrel 904E engine|Quadrijet]].<ref name="target" />
